scope: Read-only source and official API review after parent actual CUA observation; no browser interaction or clipboard test performed by this reviewer.

parent_reported_browser_observation.normal_iab: Copy click left initial status text unchanged; TabClipboard read empty and console had no error.
parent_reported_browser_observation.other_ui: Root verified desktop tab/history/keyboard, mobile width, and actual CSP-blocked NoJS separately.

source_facts: Status changes only after clipboard.writeText settles. There is no immediate progress message or timer.
A thrown TypeError (missing clipboard API) or rejected write promise reaches the existing generic manual-copy fallback.
A promise that stays pending leaves the initial status unchanged. A click not entering the handler would also do so.
The caught exception is not logged, so no console error does not prove API success.
TabClipboard empty is not a byte-for-byte proof of the browser platform clipboard outcome.

recommendation.minimal: Set immediate copying/manual-copy guidance before invoking writeText. Preserve resolve-only copied confirmation and catch fallback.
recommendation.optional_bounded_feedback: After 3 seconds show Copy was not confirmed. Select and copy the commands above. This is a UX observation deadline, not proof of clipboard failure or cancellation.
recommendation.late_completion: The API has no AbortSignal argument. A timeout cannot undo a later clipboard write; do not label timeout cancelled. Guard stale status updates if repeated attempts are allowed.
avoid: Do not add deprecated execCommand fallback merely to bypass security policies.
Do not claim actual copy success based on a Node/mock promise resolving.
Do not copy clipboard contents into diagnostic logs.

actual_browser_permission_denial: Serve temporary same-source local review URL with HTTP Permissions-Policy: clipboard-write=().
Use actual user click in focused secure-context page, retain response-header provenance and status/console DOM observations.
Expected application fallback: Copy is unavailable. Select and copy the commands above.
Remove test-only response policy afterward; do not apply denial to production site.
software_branch_only: Stub writeText with Promise.reject(new DOMException(..., NotAllowedError)) to exercise catch, explicitly label as simulated denial rather than real permission validation.
Stub a never-settling promise to test immediate and bounded manual-copy feedback; not evidence that actual browser promise hangs.
success: Focused permitted-browser real click and exact manual paste of expected commands can demonstrate actual write; permission-query or unrelated clipboard-read surfaces alone cannot.
